situation: A leave is a Resident's nights away
given: a Resident in house and a front desk holding leave.grant
when: the desk gives leave from one night to another with a reason
then: it is recorded against the Stay with who gave it, when, and the nights as first granted; the last night is not before the first and a leave is at most 365 nights (23514 otherwise). Who gave it and its status are the database's, not the caller's
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-01: a front desk gives a Resident leave for three nights with a reason; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-01: who granted it and its status are the database's, and what was planned is what was granted; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-01: the last night is not before the first; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-01: leave may begin before today, for a desk recording it late

situation: Leave is for a Resident whose Stay is coming or current
given: a Guest's stay, a Resident who has left, and a Resident who has not yet arrived
then: refused (RZL01) for a Guest's stay, for a Stay that has departed and for nights before the Stay begins; given from the day a Resident's Stay begins, including before they arrive
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-02: a Guest's stay is not given leave, only a Resident's; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-02: nor a Resident who has left; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-02: nor for nights before the Stay begins; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-02: a Resident who has yet to arrive is given leave from the day the Stay begins

situation: One Resident is not away twice on one night
given: a Resident away on three nights
when: leave is given that shares a night with it
then: refused (23P01) by an exclusion constraint, so two desks racing cannot both succeed; a cancelled leave frees its nights. The module says so as its own error
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-03: one Resident is not away twice on one night; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-03: a Resident already away on a night is not given it again

situation: A leave has a reason, kept apart
given: a leave and its reason
when: they are written, or the leave is written alone
then: a reason is trimmed and 2 to 300 characters (23514); a leave cannot commit without one (RZL03), checked when the transaction ends so either may be written first. The module measures it first and names the field
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-04: a leave cannot commit without a reason; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-04: a reason is trimmed and at least two characters; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-04: a reason and the nights are measured before the database is asked

situation: A leave is never deleted or rewritten
given: a leave, granted or closed
when: anyone, the owner of the table included, deletes it, reopens it or rewrites its reason
then: refused: a closed leave is not reopened (RZL02), a leave is not deleted and a reason is not rewritten (42501). The history is the record
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-05: a closed leave is not reopened; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-05: a leave is never deleted; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-05: a leave is not deleted by the owner; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-05: a reason is what was said, not rewritten by the owner

situation: Back from leave: ended or cancelled by whether a night of it has passed
given: a leave that has not begun, and one that has
when: the desk marks the Resident back
then: a leave none of whose nights has passed is cancelled; one with a night passed is ended at the last night spent away, shorter than it was and not before the first, so the nights spent away stay on the record. The database refuses the other way round (RZL02), who closed it and when are stamped, and a closed leave cannot be closed again
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-06: a leave none of whose nights has passed is cancelled; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-06: with who cancelled it and when, and it stays on the record; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-06: a leave with a night already passed is not cancelled, it is ended; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-06: ending cannot make a leave longer; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-06: a begun leave is ended at the last night spent away; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-06: shorter than it was planned, with who ended it; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-06: a leave that has begun is ended at the last night spent away, one that has not is cancelled

situation: Only leave.grant gives, ends or cancels leave
given: a night warden holding attendance.take only, a housekeeper, and a Property without the capability
then: refused (42501) by the policy; the desk, manager and owner do
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-07: a warden who may call the roll may not give leave; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-07: a warden may not give leave

situation: The roll call reads who is away and not why
given: a warden, a role that only gives leave, a housekeeper
when: each reads the leaves and the reasons
then: the warden reads every leave and no reason; leave.grant reads both; a housekeeper reads neither. A reason can be a medical or a family matter of a minor, so it is a table of its own and the database refuses, not the screen
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-08: the roll call reads who is away, all of it, cancelled and ended too; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-08: and reads no reason; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-08: whoever gives leave reads why; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-08: a housekeeper reads no leave, no roll, no reason; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-08: the roll call reads who is away and not why; the desk reads both

situation: An answer is a row, and a correction is another above it
given: a Resident marked absent
then: both rows stay with who made each and when; the latest is the current answer, ordered by an identity column so two answers in one millisecond still have an order. A second tap on the answer already standing writes nothing
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-09: a night warden marks a Resident absent; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-09: and corrects it; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-09: both stay, in order, each with who made it: the later is current; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-16: a second tap writes nothing and a changed answer is a correction above the old

situation: Only attendance.take calls the roll
given: a role that only gives leave, a housekeeper
then: refused (42501). leave.grant and attendance.take read the answers, so the desk sees the roll beside the leave; only attendance.take writes them
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-10: and reads the marks, to see the roll beside the leave; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-10: but may not call the roll; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-10: and a housekeeper calls no roll; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-10: whoever may not call the roll cannot, and the roll is no secret kept from the desk

situation: A Resident is called only on a night of their Stay
given: a night to come, a night before the Stay, a Guest, a Resident who left
then: refused (RZA01): not tomorrow, not before the Stay began, not a Guest's stay, not on or after the day a Resident left; a late roll call for a night of a Stay since ended is still one
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-11: nobody is called for a night still to come; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-11: nor for a night before the Stay began; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-11: nor a Guest, only a Resident; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-11: nor on a night after the Resident left; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-11: but on a night of the Stay they have since left, a late roll call is still one

situation: An answer is never rewritten or deleted
given: a mark
when: anyone, the owner of the table included, updates or deletes it
then: refused (42501) by a trigger that binds every role, as the audit log and the business day closes do
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-12: a mark is never rewritten; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-12: nor deleted; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-12: a mark is not rewritten by the owner either; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-12: nor deleted by the owner

situation: Leave outranks a mark
given: a Resident marked absent who is then given leave for tonight
then: they are on leave and not absent; if the leave is cancelled the absent mark counts again. Derived at read, so neither is rewritten
test_name: leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-13: leave outranks a mark, and cancelling the leave brings the mark back; attendance-figures.test.ts: where a Resident stands on a night (LA-S1-13) is on leave whatever was marked, since leave outranks a mark

situation: The figures are counted from the rows listed
given: a night with Residents present, absent, on leave and not yet called
when: the roll call and Today read it
then: in house, on leave, present, absent (not on leave: missing) and not yet called are counted from the same rows in one snapshot, so a figure and its list cannot disagree; the same read serves Today (RANZ-108)
test_name: leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-14: walks block, floor, room and bed, and counts what it lists; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-14: Today's figures are the screen's, counted from the same rows; attendance-figures.test.ts: the figures of a night (LA-S1-14) are the rows counted, so the list and the figures cannot disagree

situation: Marking the rest present never overwrites
given: a floor with some answered, one absent and one away
when: the desk marks the rest present
then: only the Residents with no answer and no leave are marked; an absent mark and a Resident on leave are left as they are
test_name: leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-15: marking the rest present leaves the answered and the away alone

situation: The curfew is a Property's own, with a default
given: a dormitory that has set none, one that set 04:00, one that set none on purpose, a curfew earlier than the cutoff
then: no row: the application's default (23:00 for a dormitory, none for a hotel); a row: its time, or none; a curfew has passed from the curfew moment of the business night on, at 23:00 exactly and not before, and a curfew earlier than the Property's cutoff (00:30) belongs to the next calendar day. No function reads the operating model: the default is the application's
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-17: at 22:59:59 local the 23:00 curfew has not passed; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-17: at 23:00 local it has; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-17: a curfew earlier than the cutoff belongs to the next calendar day, 00:30 on the 3rd; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-17: and has passed at 00:30 on the 3rd; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-17: no curfew has never passed; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-17: a dormitory starts with the application's default, and a Property's own replaces it

situation: Only configuration.manage sets the curfew
given: a night warden and an owner
then: the warden is refused (42501); the owner sets it, stamped with who and when, and it is audited; a value that is not a time is refused naming the field
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-18: nor set the curfew, which asks configuration.manage; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-18: whoever holds configuration.manage sets the curfew; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-18: stamped with who set it; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-18: only whoever configures the Property sets it, and only a time

situation: A Property keeps attendance only if it has the capability
given: a Property of the same Organization without the attendance capability, whose desk holds both permissions
when: the desk calls the roll or gives leave there
then: refused (42501), and the roll call reads as nothing, not as an empty roll; the capability is gate 3 of blueprint 3.5. A dormitory has it on from the start, a hotel is given it like any other capability
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-19: a Property without the attendance capability takes no roll; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-19: and gives no leave; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-19: a Property that does not keep attendance has no roll call

situation: Nothing here reads the operating model
given: every policy, trigger, function and constraint of the feature
when: the operating-model suite scans the catalogue
then: none mentions operating_model; the default curfew is the application's. The only statement that does is the migration's one-time choice of which Properties start with the capability, as ADR 0057 allows
test_name: operating_model.test.sql: CF-S4-05 (all policies, functions, triggers, constraints and indexes)

situation: Each action leaves a record without the reason in it
given: leave given, ended and cancelled, a roll call answered and corrected, the curfew changed
then: an audit record per action at the Property: resident_leave.granted, .ended, .cancelled, roll_call.recorded, roll_call.corrected and attendance_setting.changed, carrying ids, nights and counts, never the reason or a name
test_name: leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-16: a second tap writes nothing and a changed answer is a correction above the old; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-17: a dormitory starts with the application's default, and a Property's own replaces it; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S1-06: a leave that has begun is ended at the last night spent away, one that has not is cancelled

situation: Two permissions of their own
given: the permission catalogue and the shipped roles
then: attendance.take and leave.grant are in the catalogue under Front Office, held by the shipped Owner, Manager and Front desk and by no other shipped role; an Organization gives either to a role of its own, or takes it away
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-22: attendance.take and leave.grant are in the catalogue, under Front Office; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-22: the shipped Owner, Manager and Front desk hold both; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-22: housekeeping and finance hold neither

situation: The runtime role writes only what it is meant to
given: the four tables
when: the runtime role and the worker are granted on them
then: the runtime role may insert marks and reasons, insert and update leaves (status and last night only) and the curfew, and delete nothing; nobody else is granted anything; every table forces its policies on its owner
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-23: the runtime role is granted no delete, truncate, reference or trigger anywhere; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-23: and may update a leave and the curfew only: a mark and a reason are written once; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-23: nobody else is granted the tables; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-23: every table forces its policies on its owner too

situation: Another Organization sees and writes nothing
given: a manager of another Organization
when: they read or write this Organization's leave and roll
then: nothing is read; a write is refused because the Resident is not found by someone who does not reach them
test_name: leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-24: another Organization's manager reads nothing of this one; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-24: and writes nothing to it, the Resident not being found by someone who does not reach them; leave_and_attendance.test.sql: LA-S1-24: a Resident of another Organization cannot be named in this one's roll

situation: The roll call is offered only where a Property keeps one
given: a hotel Property, a dormitory Property whose capability is off, a dormitory with it on, and a role holding neither permission
then: the rail offers Roll call under Front Office only for a Property that has the attendance capability and a viewer holding attendance.take or leave.grant; the page reads as no destination for the others, as every other gated page does. The rail, the Property switcher and the page ask one gate. Proposed amendment to SP-S6-01: a Front desk is offered eleven pages, not ten, where the capability is on
test_name: leave-and-attendance.spec.ts: a Property without the capability offers no roll call, and a front desk that has it is offered one; leave-and-attendance.test.ts: LA-S2-01: the roll call is offered where the capability is on and the viewer may call it or give leave

situation: Residents are listed as a warden walks them
given: a yurt of two blocks, floors one and two, rooms let by the bed
then: grouped by block, then floor, then room and bed in natural order, so room 9 comes before room 10; a room with no block or floor is listed under its own heading at the end rather than dropped
test_name: attendance-grouping.test.ts: LA-S2-02: building, then floor, then room and bed in the order a warden walks them

situation: Present is one tap on the row; absent is one button; the keys do both
given: an uncalled Resident, one already answered, a desk with a keyboard
when: the desk taps the row, presses Absent, or presses P or A on the focused row
then: a tap on the body of an uncalled row marks it present and nothing else is touched; an answered row ignores a tap on its body so a stray touch cannot change it, and the buttons change it (a correction, kept above the old answer). P and A answer the focused row and move to the next; arrows, Home and End walk the rows. Every control is a real button with a name for a screen reader
test_name: leave-and-attendance.spec.ts: the desk takes tonight's roll in a few taps, and the figures follow; leave-and-attendance.spec.ts: the keyboard walks the rows: P and A answer and move on

situation: Every figure opens the rows it counts
given: tonight's five figures
then: the list narrows to the Residents it counts and the figure shows as pressed; pressing it again, or Show everyone, restores the list. Missing is the Residents marked absent who are not on leave, and is red above nothing; Not yet called is amber only once the curfew has passed. With nobody matching, the list says so
test_name: leave-and-attendance.spec.ts: the desk takes tonight's roll in a few taps, and the figures follow; attendance-grouping.test.ts: LA-S2-04: a figure narrows the list to the Residents it counts

situation: A Resident on leave is not markable
given: a Resident away tonight
then: the row says until when and, to a desk that may give leave, why; it offers neither Present nor Absent. The figures count them as on leave and not as missing, and not as not yet called
test_name: leave-and-attendance.spec.ts: leave is given from the row, keeps the person off the roll, and is cancelled in one press

situation: The curfew is said where the roll is taken, and changed there
given: a dormitory with the default curfew, one with its own, one with none, an evening before and after it
when: the desk reads the line; a person who may configure the Property presses it
then: the line says the time, that it is the default, and that it has passed; without a curfew it says so. Whoever holds configuration.manage changes it in place or clears it; anyone else reads it. Before the curfew an uncalled Resident is simply not yet called; after it the figure is flagged
test_name: leave-and-attendance.spec.ts: the curfew is said, changed by whoever configures, and decides what 'not yet called' means

situation: Leave is given from the row, prefilled
given: a Resident on the roll
when: the desk presses Give leave on their row
then: the dialog opens on that Resident and on tonight alone, so the usual leave is a reason and one press; it asks only for what the row cannot say, the nights and the reason, and says why the reason is read by few. The button is disabled, with a hint, until the reason is long enough
test_name: leave-and-attendance.spec.ts: leave is given from the row, keeps the person off the roll, and is cancelled in one press

situation: Leave from the toolbar asks who first
given: a desk giving leave to somebody who is not in view
when: they press Give leave above the list
then: the dialog opens with a searchable picker of the Residents in house, then asks the same two things as from a row
test_name: leave-and-attendance.spec.ts: leave is given from the row, keeps the person off the roll, and is cancelled in one press

situation: Back and cancel are one press on the thing itself
given: a leave that has begun, one that begins tonight, one still to come
when: the desk presses the button on the row or in the leave list
then: a leave that has begun is ended (Back), so the nights spent away stay on the record; one that has not begun is cancelled. The label says which, and the database refuses the other way round
test_name: leave-and-attendance.spec.ts: leave is given from the row, keeps the person off the roll, and is cancelled in one press

situation: A floor is answered in one press
given: a floor with some uncalled Residents, some answered, some on leave
when: the desk presses Mark the other N present on its heading
then: only the uncalled are answered present; an absent is never overwritten and a Resident on leave is left alone. The button is offered only to a desk that may call the roll and only while somebody is uncalled
test_name: leave-and-attendance.spec.ts: the desk takes tonight's roll in a few taps, and the figures follow; attendance-grouping.test.ts: LA-S2-10: the rest of a floor is those not yet called

situation: Empty and failed states are said
given: nobody in house, a failed save, a stale screen, a lost connection
then: an empty yurt says nobody is in house; a failed save returns the row to how it was and says nothing changed, in words that name no code; a refusal says the page may be out of date; an answer is shown at once and a Saving line says it is not yet kept
test_name: attendance-roll-call.test.tsx: LA-S2-11: a refused answer goes back and says so

situation: The roll call reads in Turkish, English and Arabic
given: each language, at desktop and tablet width
then: every string is in all three catalogues; Arabic mirrors by logical directions; the figures, rows, leave dialog and curfew control hold at 1440 and 820 pixels wide
test_name: leave-and-attendance.spec.ts: the roll call in Turkish, English and Arabic, at desktop and tablet width

situation: A dormitory created later is given attendance from the control plane
given: a Property switched to the dormitory model after the migration, which backfilled the capability only for those that were then
then: nothing grants the capability when the model is switched: capabilities are the commercial gate and are set from the control plane, and the operating model only picks defaults and words (ADR 0057). apps/control-plane is not yet implemented, so until it is the capability is given by the seed scripts and by an operator in the database; the roll call is simply absent from the rail until then, and Today's card must read the same gate

situation: The guardian is told that a student is missing
given: a student absent and not on leave after the curfew
when: the desk would tell the veli
then: deferred: RANZ-112 sends messages by SMS and needs the delivery foundation (RANZ-85) and the guardian contact (RANZ-99). The figures name who is missing; nothing is sent

situation: The guardian's number is on a missing student's row
given: a missing student and a role that reads particulars
then: deferred: ADR 0058 reads particulars for one booking and never with a list; a missing student's row would be a small list. RANZ-112 decides how the number reaches the person who calls

situation: Guests are called as well
given: a dormitory's summer Guests
then: deferred: attendance is a rule about students, and the Stay type says who is one. A Property that wants Guests called would make it a setting

situation: Visitors and parcels
given: a visitor at the door or a parcel at the desk
then: deferred: the rest of RANZ-101, designed with the partner yurt (RANZ-104)

situation: A student asks for leave from the Portal
given: a Resident with a Portal login
when: they ask for a night out
then: deferred: needs Portal access for a Resident (RANZ-87) and an approval step, which is a product decision for the partner yurt. Leave here is given by the desk, which is also how the paper form works

situation: A Resident's history of leave and roll
given: a student whose attendance a guardian disputes
then: deferred: every leave and every revision is kept, and the audit log shows the actions; a screen per Resident reading them is its own slice

situation: Changing a leave's dates
given: a leave given for the wrong nights
then: deferred: cancel it while no night has passed and give it again, or end it. Editing in place would rewrite history this feature keeps

situation: Today shows the figures
given: a dormitory's Today
then: deferred to the orchestrator, which adds the card after the other lane's change to Today (RANZ-108): the module's figuresTonight is the one read it takes

situation: A curfew by day or by block, or a leave by the hour
given: a weekend curfew, a block with its own, a student out until 01:00
then: deferred: one curfew per Property and leave in whole nights is the general case. Per-day or per-block curfews and leave by the hour are specialisations for the partner yurt

situation: A report of absences over a term
given: a manager reviewing a term
then: deferred: the rows are kept for it; the report and its inclusion in the data export are their own slice
